principle: Material separation is a structural readability problem, not a request for more texture everywhere.

prompt_translation: Separate the garment materials clearly where present in the reference: the main robe should feel denser and more structured, any existing gauze lighter and semi-transparent, existing gold floral patterns woven or embroidered rather than printed, and existing waist/collar/tie structures visibly more defined. Do not add missing gauze, gold motifs or accessories.
Do not let all layers share the same soft glossy fantasy surface.
